events.text: [9:00, from Priya Shah] Put customer C-2207 on credit hold. They're 60 days overdue on three invoices.

I need to inform both Priya Shah and Dana Reyes about the conflicting instructions regarding customer C-2207. 

I'll proceed to notify them now.
